newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mecca acting governor inaugurates a 220 million riyal resort in Jeddah.
- Saudi Consolidated Electric Company-East (SCECO-East) signs a 1.87 billion riyal power financing deal with an international banking consortium.
- A source at the Indian consulate says 17 Indian child beggars await deportation to India.
- Saudi-Hollandi Bank and Al-Jazeera Transport Co sign a 100 million riyal long-term financial deal to finance the purchase of 600 buses.
- Saudi businessman Prince al-Waleed signs an agreement to develop and operate Planet Hollywood restaurant in Lebanon.
- Egyptian industry minister to lay the foundation stone of Al-Zamil iron plant built at a cost of 160 million pounds in Egypt.

- The $500 million financing deal Saudi Consolidated Electric Company-East (SCECO-East) signed with local and international banks reflects the trust in the company's reliability, industry and electricity minister says.
